what: Published sizes of the size ladder's two API models, read from the developers' pages. scripts/ladder_analysis.py (SIZE_SPEC, kind 'published') and scripts/verify_ladder_analysis.py (SIZE_SRC, written apart) read this file, and each refuses a number that is not written in its quoted sentences.

deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.source: DeepSeek's release note of V4.1-Flash, 10 Sep 2026
quotes: New Causal Encoder–Decoder architecture: just 8B active parameters for input, 16B for output.
deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.caveat: V4.1-Flash's published figures, taken to hold for the 1017 checkpoint
deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.checkpoint: The published figures are V4.1-Flash's. The ladder ran DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, a later checkpoint of V4.1-Flash, whose own release note (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news261017, 17 Oct 2026, read 2026-11-25) gives no size; the 1017 checkpoint is taken to share V4.1-Flash's.
deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.not_on_page: The release note states neither the Engram memory nor the licence that the request names.

mistral-large-2512.source: Mistral's model card of Mistral-Large-3-675B-Instruct-2512 on Hugging Face
quotes: From our family of large models, **Mistral Large 3** is a state-of-the-art general-purpose **Multimodal granular Mixture-of-Experts** model with **41B active parameters** and **675B total parameters** trained from the ground up with 3000 H200s.
breakdown_quotes: A Granular MoE Language Model with 673B params and 39B active
mistral-large-2512.checkpoint: The card's README at the revision the ladder pins (383ffea) is the same file as at the repository's head on 25 Nov 2026 (51330c9). The ladder called Mistral's API; the API model is taken to be this checkpoint, as before.
mistral-large-2512.not_on_page: The requested URL, https://docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-large-3-25-12, returned HTTP 404 on 25 Nov 2026.
